builds.name: Piercing Light: concentrated AD beam
builds.summary: Investigate high one Piercing Light beam impact output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Piercing Light beam impact output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Q deals 90/130/170/210/250 + 1.0 bonus AD physical damage. Penetration and earned bonus AD are the direct experiment. Piercing through an initial unit can deliver the beam to a distant champion without making every unit hit add damage to that champion.
